notes.title: Prelaunch Update
notes.content:
-Made the player character's movements a little more bouncy, and his legs a little more waggly.

-Added a new idle animations to the player character.

-Fixed an issue that made the some recording/streaming software fail to see the game.

-Fixed a typo in the credits.

-Fixed a bug that caused the score to overflow into negative numbers if the player was insanely good.
